requirement: Foundation 2.1 E08; S07 explicit offer-deadline request and S12 specific deferral review
implemented: Each saved current S07 offer has a request-only deadline reminder entry bound to its workspace, pickup, offer identity and saved revision; past-cutoff offers have no contextual request action.
Each S12 review deferral exposes its own request-only entry while the local choice remains Keep deferred; accepted/handled/dismissed local choices suppress it.
Both routes reuse the existing typed ReminderEditorContext, ReminderCoordinator, private route store, generic notification body and source/persona authorization checks.
Opening/preparing/reviewing creates no desired reminder, permission request, order decision, purchase, arrival or charge. Only explicit Schedule may request notification permission.
Shows item identity, pickup saved date, selected local date/time, time zone, expiry, offer cutoff when present, default quiet hours and read-only current saved status.

Pending, scheduled, off, denied, expired and retry states are distinct; a saved scheduled state displays its saved date and zone. Cancel and Turn off use existing source-safe navigation/coordinator paths.
No reminders were added for undated dinners, general meal repair or other unsupported subjects.

coverage: Preparing/reopening typed offer and deferral contexts keeps stable reminder/route IDs without creating reminder state or mutating pickup history.
Wrong workspace, pickup, subject kind, source revision, duplicate candidates and passed cutoff fail closed.
Source edits and locked workspace invalidate the prior authorization.
Explicit save with the isolated denied adapter and subsequent cancellation preserve pending retailer response and review deferral.
Creating a next-shop successor retires prior contextual targets without changing the original purchase.
native_model_validation.fixture_isolation: Private temporary stores and UserDefaults suites; DEBUG-only isolated notification adapter. Composition-owned SQLite actors have no public close port, so temporary store files remain until process/container cleanup.

device.name: Room in the Cart iOS 17 Small

normal_app_ui_validation.entry: Ordinary shipping SwiftUI Shop/list/checkout routes, manually typed fictional groceries, no preseeded grocery data, fixture authority or deep link. --ui-testing isolates persistence and uses the existing non-OS denied notification adapter.

cases.name: ContextualReminderUITests/testNextShopDeferralRequestsReminderOnlyAfterExplicitScheduleAndCanCancel
assertions: Create and review a real specific coffee deferral from Shop.
Open contextual reminder, explicitly confirm expiry, review chosen time while nothing is scheduled and no permission alert exists.
Explicit Schedule displays denied/unscheduled under the isolated adapter; Turn off displays off.
Cancel preserves the old deferral; a local Already handled choice suppresses its request entry and cancelling that choice restores the deferral.

cases.name: ContextualReminderUITests/testSavedOfferRequestsDeadlineReminderFromThatOfferAndCancelKeepsDecisionPending
assertions: Create a real pickup, explicitly freeze/report placement, enter a saved store offer and select a future cutoff through the native calendar.
Open the exact offer deadline reminder and verify source identity, dated cutoff, initial off/unscheduled state and no permission alert.
Cancel returns to the saved offer with retailer response still Pending and reminder request still available.

harness_setting.reason: Newer XCTest snapshot instrumentation on iOS 17 crashed in runtime_issue_os_log_fault_callback / LIBTRACE high-logging-volume quarantine. XCTest action and assertion logs remain enabled. This run makes no claim about absence of runtime warnings; B01 accessibility audits remain separate and unfiltered.

prior_attempts.corrections: Test helpers now handle native iOS 17 full-date calendar labels, sheet-covered tab bars, passive text viewport checks and actual unobscured action touch points. No product feature changes were required by those failed attempts.

verification_scope: The simulator uses the isolated denied notification adapter. Real notification authorization UI, OS registration/delivery and signed-device behavior are not asserted by this placement evidence.
Normal UI evidence is English on iOS 17 Small. Added strings include English/US Spanish translations; this is not a separate full Spanish or VoiceOver/Dynamic Type acceptance run.
The scheduler and generic notification payload were reused unchanged; existing package tests cover permission/retry/cancellation/DST/quiet-hour behavior.

localization_validation.scope: Structural source/translation and format-argument checks; dynamic/runtime compositions and human language review remain separate.
